crew.overview: After settling in Green Hills, Sonic is eager to prove he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns, this time with a new partner, Knuckles, in search for an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.
crew.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2

crew.overview: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails reunite against a powerful new adversary, Shadow, a mysterious villain with powers unlike anything they have faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, Team Sonic must seek out an unlikely alliance in hopes of stopping Shadow and protecting the planet.
crew.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3

details.biography: Shuji Utsumi is president/COO of Sega Corporation and CEO of Sega America and Europe, having been promoted in January 2024. Before his promotion, Utsumi was co-COO, president of consumer games and transmedia, and representative director of Sega Corporation.
details.name: Shuji Utsumi
